resources.string: Unlock to read the saved alert.
On-device translation may be inaccurate. Follow the original alert and official guidance.
A translation model is not ready. Prepare it on Wi-Fi.
Could not identify a supported source language.
Could not complete this action. The original is preserved. Retry when ready.
These are capture and source reception times. The disaster occurrence time is not verified.

Android 13+ may block access for directly installed APKs. Open App info → More → Allow restricted settings, then enable each access separately. If the menu is missing, open the Android app list below, select CodeClear, and open More there. Menus vary; device administrators may prevent changes.
Translate on this device with ML Kit. Chinese script conversion supports simplified and traditional output.

Originals and translations stay in private device storage until you delete them. No account or synchronization. App backup and transfer are disabled. Alert text is sent only when you separately allow and use a remote translation service. Review that service’s retention and deletion disclosure.

CodeClear works on Android 11+ phones and tablets. Direct emergency-alert reception requires cellular hardware. Wi-Fi-only devices can still show saved records and translations. Complete capture depends on the installed alert receiver and firmware; tested profiles do not establish worldwide support. Capture starts after the first unlock following reboot.

Android notification access can expose notifications from other apps. CodeClear reads only reviewed installed system emergency-receiver sources and saves individual complete alert text in private local history for on-device translation. It does not open screens automatically. Turn capture off here or revoke access in Android Settings at any time. Remote translation requires separate permission for each service.

CodeClear uses accessibility to read the single message field, title, and pending count in reviewed system emergency-alert dialogs. Other screens and history rows are excluded. It does not perform gestures or dismiss warnings. Originals stay in private history for local translation. This is not a disability assistance tool. Turn capture off here or revoke access in Android Settings at any time. Remote translation requires separate permission for each service.

Enable automatic on-device translation of captured alerts. Language models require a separate Wi-Fi download approval. No alert text is sent to a translation server. Turning this off stops new translations while preserving your history.
Access is enabled; service is reconnecting. Recheck in Android Settings if this continues.
Capture and translation are paused to avoid losing records. Check available storage and retry. Check capture permissions again afterward.
Android receives cellular emergency broadcasts through its built-in alert feature. Wi-Fi-only hardware cannot receive those broadcasts directly.

In Settings, review notification and accessibility disclosures, then enable each access in Android Settings. Notifications can expose individual text; accessibility reads the visible system alert dialog. If only a summary is available, open the original alert from Home. Hidden pending messages are not automatically dismissed to read them.

Enable local translation and choose a target language. Approve model preparation on Wi-Fi when prompted. Ready models work offline. Tap a result notification to open its original and translation; search saved records in History. Delete records whenever you choose.
This device has no cellular receiver for emergency alerts sent by cell towers. A Wi-Fi connection alone cannot receive these broadcasts. You can still view saved records and translations.
Cellular radio capability could not be verified. Current Wi-Fi use, SIM absence, and mobile data settings do not determine hardware capability.
No reviewed system alert receiver was found. Automatic capture is unavailable for this source profile.
Allow notification or accessibility access in Settings to capture alerts. Both routes improve coverage.
Ready to collect message bodies exposed by supported system alert sources.
The latest source observation did not expose a verified complete individual body. The saved alert below may be older. Open the original system alert to check it.
Pending alerts reported by the source: %1$d. Only exposed individual bodies can be captured; open the original to check the others.
Newly captured alerts appear here. An empty screen does not establish whether an emergency alert was issued or received.
Preparing models or waiting for Wi-Fi. Android may continue the download in the background.
This record was deleted or is unavailable.
This removes the selected originals and translations from this app. It does not delete or dismiss system emergency alerts. This cannot be undone.
Open Android Settings → Apps → CodeClear and select the relevant access setting.
System translation is unavailable. Choose ML Kit in Settings or check the system translation service.
The selected engine does not support this language pair. Choose another engine or target language.
Prepare language models in the system translation settings, then retry.
System translation settings are unavailable or busy. Try again or choose ML Kit.
The source language matches the target. Chinese script conversion may apply.
No result for this engine and language yet. Tap Retry to translate this record.
Use ready on-device language pairs from the installed system service. Chinese script conversion supports simplified and traditional output.

Use the installed Android system service for captured alert text through the public on-device translation API. Only language pairs reported as ready receive text. CodeClear does not upload alert text to an app translation server. Review the service privacy information and prepare models in its own settings. Turning this off stops new work and preserves history.
No compatible system translation service is available. Choose ML Kit or review the system service settings.
For %1$s: ready pairs %2$d; pairs needing preparation %3$d. Source-language support is checked for each alert.
The system service does not report a language pair for %1$s. Choose another target language or ML Kit.
Changing engines keeps the current translation on/off choice. Existing results retain their producing engine.
Shows captured alert text and updates the same notification when translation is ready. Lock-screen previews follow Android privacy settings.
Could not open the link. Check your browser settings and try again.
The original language could not be identified. Keep the original and try again.

Freshly captured originals are available to nearby users. Received messages have unverified origin and authenticity. They are automatically saved in private history until you delete them and are never forwarded again.

Bluetooth sharing can continue in the background with a persistent status notification. Stop it here or from the notification. No GPS coordinates or server are used. Android may stop the app; reopen it to resume.
No recent messages. You can find previously received messages in History.
Could not save. Check sharing access and available storage.
BLE is unavailable on this device
Looking for nearby devices · receive only
Exchange stopped. Check access and try again.

CodeClear needs location permission and system location on Android 11 to discover nearby Bluetooth devices while this app is visible. It does not collect location coordinates or determine your location. Sharing pauses when you leave the app; background location access is not requested.
Experimental features may change. Nearby sharing stays off until you allow it.
Labs is unlocked. Open it from Settings.
Could not save a received message. Nearby history is limited to 1,000 records. Check storage or delete unwanted nearby records, then try saving again. Existing history is preserved.
Receiving with Bluetooth in the background. Tap to open the app or stop sharing.
Background reception is not running. Keep the app open and check access.
Automatic translation. Check the original too.
No installed offline voice is available for this language. Add an offline voice in the device text-to-speech settings.
Android exposes no compatible public translation language pairs. An installed translation app may keep its service private. Check provider settings or use ML Kit.
Could not query the system translation service. Try again; support has not been confirmed.
ML Kit does not expose model versions or a separate update list. Installed models can be checked; an available update uses Wi-Fi. English is the base language; both Chinese scripts share one model.
Installed · Tap to check for updates
Could not read the model list. Try again.
These permissions let the app read emergency alerts and notify you when translations are ready. Allow access in Android settings, then return to continue.
Allow notifications in Android to see captured alerts and translation updates.
CodeClear keeps emergency-alert originals on your device and translates them into a language you understand. Read, search or listen to saved messages. It supplements the original system warning.
Preparation stopped. Models already downloaded remain available.
The source language is checked first. The required download may change.
The SDK does not expose byte counts or percentages. Completed language models are shown. You can close this window while preparation continues.
Each language model is about 30 MB. Downloads use Wi-Fi and storage, and may continue after closing this window. Alert text is not uploaded for model preparation.

Force stopping CodeClear in Android App info can turn off its accessibility service. Open accessibility settings and enable it again. After a normal restart, unlock the device and allow the service to reconnect. CodeClear cannot turn on OS access for you.

Allow automatic server translation of collected alerts and requested history translations. Original alert text and language pairs are sent over the internet to MyMemory (Translated), including unverified nearby messages when you open their details or request a translation. The provider states that submitted segments are stored long term and may be processed by translation partners. Anonymous use is limited to 5,000 characters per day and a shared network may reach the limit sooner. No account or key is requested. Turning this off stops new requests; it cannot recall data already sent. ML Kit remains available for on-device translation.
Allow server translation in Settings before using MyMemory.
The MyMemory daily limit has been reached. A shared network may exhaust it sooner. Try again on another day.
This message exceeds the bounded MyMemory request size. The original was not truncated. Use on-device translation.
Automatic translation may be inaccurate. Follow the original alert and official guidance.
Could not copy or share this text.
These models are installed. Check whether ML Kit has an update.
Update check completed. Models are ready.
Available updates may download over Wi-Fi. No model is downloaded when no update is needed. ML Kit does not report version numbers or whether files changed. No alert text is sent.

Shown only after the reviewed system alert window has disappeared. If this cannot be confirmed, use the notification or history instead. Requires both collection services; no popup on the lock screen.

Allow CodeClear to show the original alert and its available translation after the system alert window disappears. To show it while another app is open, separately allow display over other apps in Android settings. This does not dismiss system warnings, wake the screen, or unlock the device. Popup delivery is best effort; notifications and history remain available. This choice is off by default.

An exemption is optional. If collection is delayed in the background, review battery and background restrictions. Exemption does not restore revoked access, a force-stopped app, or unavailable source text.
Android currently restricts background use. Review this app in system battery settings.
Identical originals share one history entry. Observations can include system redisplays and different capture paths; they do not establish separate broadcasts.
Delete this original, its translations and all collection observations grouped with the same original?
CodeClear service · Internet · Separate permission required

Send alert originals and the target language to the CodeClear service, which forwards inference to Groq. Cached results expire within 30 days; operational logs and backups have separate retention described in the privacy policy. Groq may retain data for reliability or abuse investigations. Quotas may stop translation. Turning sending off or removing the access code does not erase existing server data. Clear the server cache separately before removing the code. Other engines are never selected automatically.
32–256 characters. Use the service access token, not a Groq API key.
Remove the saved access token and pause server translation? Existing server cache is not deleted.
Could not update the access token. Try again.
Clear cached results for this access token and pause server translation? Your local history stays saved. New requests can refill the cache if you enable translation again.
Server cache cleared. Server translation is paused.
Could not clear server cache. Check your access token and connection.
Server translation unavailable. Check permission, access token and connection.
The CodeClear service limit was reached. Try again later.
This message is too long for the CodeClear service. The original is unchanged.
